thinking: The original parameters favored dense regions (right side) because: (1) minLineLength=100 is too strict for sparse data where line segments fragment; (2) maxLineGap=40 is insufficient to bridge larger gaps in sparse regions; (3) hough_threshold=50 requires many votes that sparse regions cannot provide; (4) minimal dilation (3x3 kernel, 1 iteration) does not connect scattered points. Improvements: Reduced minLineLength to 60 to capture shorter segments in sparse areas. Increased maxLineGap to 70 to bridge larger discontinuities. Lowered hough_threshold to 35 to allow detection with fewer votes. Increased kernel to 5x5 with 2 dilation iterations to better connect sparse outlier points before detection. Widened angle ranges from ±[6,9] to ±[5,10] to capture slight angular variations. These changes accept a modest increase in false positives on the dense right side to significantly improve recall on the sparse left side.
